pokedexEntries.ru: ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This POKéMON’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.

pokedexEntries.sa: ARMALDO is a POKéMON species that became extinct in prehistoric times. This POKéMON is said to have walked on its hind legs, which would have been more convenient for life on land.

pokedexEntries.frlg: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

pokedexEntries.em: ARMALDO usually lives on land. However, when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath the ocean. It swims around using its two large wings.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Its enormous, retractable claws can cut through most anything. Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates.

pokedexEntries.bw: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.

pokedexEntries.x: Its enormous, retractable claws can cut through most anything. Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates.

pokedexEntries.y: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

pokedexEntries.or: Armaldo’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This Pokémon’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.

pokedexEntries.as: Armaldo is a Pokémon species that became extinct in prehistoric times. This Pokémon is said to have walked on its hind legs, which would have been more convenient for life on land.

pokedexEntries.us: It lived on land and went out into the sea to hunt for prey. Its sharp claws were its greatest weapon.

pokedexEntries.um: Armaldo adapted from living in water to living on land. It has been determined that it is the ancestor of some bug Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.sw: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.

pokedexEntries.sh: Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
